title: FBI Photo B003
sensor_system_note: B-series — large full-frame crosshair reticle, '12/31/99 HH:MM:SS' factory-reset sensor clock visible bottom-left, scale markings '15 10 5 | 5 10 15' in burst-1 / early burst-2 and '3' after the high-mag zoom at B022. Sky/atmosphere background throughout (no terrain in burst 2). Different sensor system from A-series.

pages.image_type: black-and-white video or targeting system screen capture with overlay graphics
pages.description: A grayscale image resembling a surveillance or targeting camera display with a grainy, mostly uniform gray background that darkens slightly toward the bottom. A white crosshair reticle with tick marks is centered in the frame, crossing a horizontal measurement scale marked with numbers 15, 10, 5, 5, 10, 15 reading outward from the center. Several solid black rectangular bars obscure portions of the image symmetrically on the left and right sides and across the top, appearing to be redactions. A small dark speck is visible near the center-left of the crosshair. A timestamp is displayed in white text in the lower-left corner. The bottom of the frame shows faint darker shapes suggesting a horizon or terrain.
